newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Kitchen stoves become mystery hazard near Moscow.
newsitem.headline: Kitchen stoves become mystery hazard near Moscow.

text.p: A mysterious surge of gas pressure caused a series of blasts and fires in apartments across a Moscow suburb on Wednesday, fire officials said.

Centrally-supplied gas apparently leaked into kitchens across Shcherbinka, a town of 150,000 about 10 km (six miles) outside Moscow, causing at least 13 to go up in flames, according to local officials.
Hundreds of residents evacuated their apartments and a handful were treated for minor burns.
Fire officials advised locals to avoid using the kitchen stove.
